behavior: LSC-2P finding F1, security half (owner decisions 2026-10-25 items 1, 2 and 6): the server decides who may save or delete a live co-op campaign record from the verified bearer, never from the request body. Today PUT /api/campaigns/[id] treats an envelope whose body.coopSession is {mode:"host", matchId} as the live host's own save (isLiveHostSave, [id].ts:141), so a guest profile that adopted the host-shaped record can overwrite it, the live host adopts the write and broadcasts it to the legitimate guest, and an anonymous DELETE answers 204 and removes the row. After this unit, while CampaignHostRegistry.liveEntryFor(id) holds a live host entry, PUT is accepted only when the request carries a bearer that verifies and whose principal is that entry's host, and DELETE is refused for everyone, the host's own included, until the session ends (owner ruling applied under the standing instruction; it changes the prep draft LW09); a member or guest bearer, an expired, malformed or absent bearer and a body-only coopSession are refused with a typed code and reason (HOST_SESSION_REQUIRED when there is no usable bearer, HOST_SESSION_EXPIRED when it expired; a verified non-host PUT keeps today's 409 live-coop-session conflict, owner decisions 2026-10-25b Q2 item 6), and the record, its version and the live host are untouched and nothing is broadcast. The host's browser store attaches its stored co-op bearer to record PUT; CampaignDashboardPage.tsx shows the server's refusal when Delete Campaign is refused while a session runs. The save-status card shows the server's refusal reason, keeps the unsaved changes and the dirty flag, and no longer labels a refusal "playing offline; changes are kept locally" (S4-03, refusal display only). Acceptance rows, each a failing test first: host same-tab reload (the bearer is still in sessionStorage) saves 200; host in a new window without the token is refused with the typed reason, the save card shows it and the unsaved changes are kept (disclosed: a new window cannot save a running co-op campaign, the host keeps its original window); app restart before any member reconnects (no live entry) takes the offline path and is accepted, pinned; app restart after a guest reconnected (entry live again) is refused as in the new-window row; expired host token takes the refresh path then 200, or a typed re-unlock refusal, never "kept locally"; offline host (no live entry): PUT and DELETE from another profile are accepted, pinned as disclosed behaviour so a later change is deliberate; a guest mirror save of its own record is unchanged; any DELETE while a host is live is refused, the host's own included, and works again after the session ends. Out of scope: the display half (a fresh profile rendering the HOST badge and host review surface), which owner decision 2 rewords out of Step 2 and discloses; record-scoped authority when the host is offline, the viewer-relative GET projection and the host re-authentication path, which stay with B15-3R and B15-3 after v2.2.0. The rule is keyed on the verified principal, not on a window or tab, so it does not preclude multi-window state for one identity (owner decision 6; MULTI-WINDOW-SESSION-1). It absorbs the host-save bearer attach and the live-host write rule of B15-2 and B15-3 by annotation only; neither is a predecessor.
